referenceSources.description:
A striking green Citroën Saxo VTR, built for the Junior Saloon Car Championship, stands ready for the track. Its exterior is adorned with sponsor logos including Brentwood Karting and the Teenage Cancer Trust, while the front bumper features a red tow hook and a ‘TOW’ label. Black alloy wheels and removable vinyl graphics complete its race-ready appearance.

This car was first raced in October 2016 and has been fitted with a host of new components: a custom roll cage, homologated race seat, OMP steering wheel, Sabelt six-point belts, a fuel-safe cell, fire extinguisher, new back axle, drive shafts, steering arms, bottom arms, radiator, and a fully rebuilt Mk 2 roller rocker engine. Originally listed at £9,950 on Racecarsdirect.com, the sale included spare tyres, wheels, panels, and lights, making it a comprehensive package for any aspiring JSCC competitor.
